cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Create deploy script that pulls from GitHub
deploy_script = """#!/bin/bash
# Deploy script for arelorian - pulls from GitHub
echo "=== Starting Deployment ==="
DATE=$(date)
echo "Deploy started at: $DATE"
# Navigate to project directory
cd /opt/areloria || cd /root/opt/areloria || exit 1
# If git repo exists, pull latest
if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    echo "Pulling latest from GitHub..."
    git pull origin main || echo "Git pull failed, continuing with existing code..."
else
    echo "No git repo, using existing code"
fi
# Restart PM2
echo "Restarting application..."
pm2 delete all 2>/dev/null || true
pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
# Wait and check status
sleep 5
pm2 list
echo "=== Deployment Complete ==="
echo "Finished at: $(date)"
"""
# Write deploy script
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file("/opt/areloria/deploy.sh", "w") as f:
    f.write(deploy_script)
sftp.close()
print("Created deploy.sh")
# Make it executable
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("chmod +x /opt/areloria/deploy.sh")
print("Made deploy.sh executable")
# Test the health of the app
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000/health 2>/dev/null || echo 'failed'")
print("Health check:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check PM2 status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
